India Designates Operative Linked to Ram Temple Recce, Hafiz Saeed's Son-in-Law as Terrorist

The Indian government has designated an individual as a terrorist, citing his alleged involvement in reconnaissance of the Ram Janmabhoomi complex in Ayodhya, the RSS headquarters in Nagpur, and an Indian Oil refinery in Panipat. The individual is also accused of facilitating infiltration. The designation includes Hafiz Saeed's son-in-law, who is reportedly linked to the operative.
